content:
Alex: Hey @support — customers seeing tool_result association flips when we call multiple tools in parallel. request_id=cid-9b3f, region=us-east. Two tools (price_lookup, inventory_check) invoked together but responses sometimes mapped to the wrong tool. Happened on 3 different customers today. Any quick ideas?

Maya: thanks Alex. can you paste a minimal repro + headers and correlation id? also send the raw responses if you have them.

Alex: minimal request:```json
{
  "model": "redwood-gen-1",
  "input": "check sku ABC",
  "tools": [
    {"name": "price_lookup", "args": {"sku": "ABC"}},
    {"name": "inventory_check", "args": {"sku": "ABC"}}
  ],
  "parallel": true,
  "request_id": "cid-9b3f"
}
```
raw response (trimmed):
```json
[
  {"tool_result_id": "tr-77", "tool_name": "price_lookup", "payload": {"price": 12.99}},
  {"tool_result_id": "tr-78", "tool_name": "inventory_check", "payload": {"qty": 0}}
]
```
but server logs show mapping: tr-77 -> payload of inventory_check. so tool_name != payload.tool.

Maya: got it, escalating to eng. @Jon can you take a look? logs are in region-us-east node inst-04, time ~1972100000, corr=cid-9b3f.

Jon: adding some context — likely race in dispatcher ordering when responses come back over the same connection. Could also be HTTP/2 multiplexing reorder + non-atomic mapping. Is this reproducible for you @Alex?

Alex: yes reproducible locally. curl example:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/execute -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx' -d @payload.json
```
payload.json is the JSON above. raw stdout shows tool_result metadata swapped consistently when run with --parallel flag.

Li: pinging platform — do you see any proxy-level reordering? which SDK version?

Alex: Node SDK v2.3.1, using Promise.all to call the function-call hooks concurrently (we're not batching).

Jon: two hypotheses: (1) dispatcher assigns slot ids non-atomically, race when recycling slot map; (2) response handler reuses buffer/struct and we accidentally overwrite tool_name before mapping to request. I'll add per-response seq logging and a mutex around the mapping. will push debug build to canary. ETA ~4h.

Maya: thanks. workaround for customers: set "parallel": false or add tiny jitter between tool calls. we're pushing a hotfix canary ASAP. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy:hotfix/parallel-tool-assoc -> started on canary us-east-1 by jon at 1972100070

Jon: canary run: sent 1000 parallel combos, no association failures observed after fix. patch will roll to staging then prod. @Alex can you retry after we roll?

Alex: will retry in 30m and report back. thanks all :pray:
